versions.content: Handling if EthTrcv_MacSecDeleteRxSa is called and EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecDeleteRxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthTrcvConfig identified with the given TrcvIdx • a reception secure association with the given An exists at this PHY then the EthTrcv driver shall remove the reception secure association given with An at the PHY that corresponds to the given TrcvIdx and return with E_OK .Otherwise, if addressed secured association is not available, the EthTrcv driver shall return with E_ NOT_OK .
